The only way to trigger an `IndexOutOfBoundsException` is if `property.indexOf('.')` somehow returned a value that, when 1 is added, exceeds the length of the string, which is not possible with the given `indexOf` operation. Therefore, the `IndexOutOfBoundsException` is not avoidable in the general case but in the specific context of the code, it is avoided because the `indexOf` method will not return a value that, when 1 is added, exceeds the string length.
